title: Against them
html_source: Samuel Johnson was convinced Bishop Berkeley was wrong to assert his ‘immaterialist’ idea that things only exist as long as there is a mind to perceive and contain them— but he couldn’t refute Berkeley’s argument with logic, so he kicked a stone instead.
